slug: Animal Coloring Book for Kids Ages 3-7: Fun and Easy Big Coloring Pages of Animals for Toddlers and Preschoolers
tagline: Fun and Easy Big Coloring Pages of Animals for Toddlers and Preschoolers: An Adorable Collection of Over 25 Animals to Color for Ages 2–6 to Boost Creativity and Learn Fine Motor Skills
title: Animal Coloring Book for Kids Ages 3–7: Fun and Easy Big Coloring Pages of Animals for Toddlers and Preschoolers: An Adorable Collection of Over 25 Animals to Color for Ages 2–6 to Boost Creativity and Learn Fine Motor Skills
description:
A screen-free animal coloring activity book with 25 unique animal designs from the farm, jungle, forest, and beyond. The listing mentions lions, monkeys, sheep, pigs, and other animals, with large simple outlines intended for toddlers, preschoolers, and young children.

The book is described as supporting hand-eye coordination, fine motor skills, color recognition, concentration, creativity, and learning animal names. Its single-sided pages are intended to reduce bleed-through and allow children to display their work. It is presented as suitable for birthdays, holidays, travel, rainy days, and quiet time.
